$comment: Canonical source of the shared $defs primitives. Not published on its own. scripts/schemas.mjs injects these into the self-contained format schemas (schemas/*.schema.json).

float32.description: IEEE-754 single precision (32-bit) floating point number, exactly as it is stored in the binary format. JSON has no float32 type, so it is written as a 64-bit double using the shortest decimal representation which parses back to a value rounding to the very same float32 (`Math.fround(Number(value))` gives back the original). In JavaScript a float32 can be decoded with `DataView#getFloat32` and encoded with `DataView#setFloat32` (or rounded to one with `Math.fround`) - see `BinaryIO.readFloat32Array` / `BinaryIO.writeFloat32Array` in arx-convert. Fields with the `integer` type are never float32.
